response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS excluded WHERE excluded.ID = p.ID AND excluded.`U-PRO` = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX

assumptions.assumption: A record with GPT = 0 has no defined ALP-to-GPT ratio, so it is excluded from that average.
